views.heading: # DatasetSnapshot001 — implementation logic
views.introduction: Two helpers of the existing Builder/Dataset Curator and Experience Archive. These graphs describe software contracts, not learned curation or release authorization.

views.heading: # EvaluationRun001 — pseudocode implementation flows
views.introduction: Three helpers under the existing evaluation/qualification boundary. A completed development evaluation is NOT qualification or deployment permission. A successful operation may return a FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE evaluation verdict.

views.heading: # NeuralProbe001 — implementation logic
views.introduction: Three subordinate experiment flows. `partial-simulator` is the inherited schema-v2 coverage label; the forward computation is real PyTorch, but approval and runtime hardware remain fixtures. Not production qualification.

views.heading: # QualificationEvidence002 — executable workflow logic
views.introduction: Trusted-local workflow, not authenticated authority. SUCCESS may return a rejected or inconclusive review record: only a QUALIFIED certificate can satisfy its exact claim. No result authorizes deployment.

views.heading: # LocalNexusPermissions002 — protocol logic
views.introduction: Trusted local protocol, not authenticated Nexus or an Aegis Runtime execution permit. Terminal SUCCESS can mean historical receipt or abandonment, not dispatch permission.

views.heading: # OverlayGenerationManager001 — local catalogue lifecycle
views.introduction: A whole family is staged and its catalogue pointer/archive/receipt published atomically. This is not device loading or production deployment. History is not renewed permission.

views.heading: # OverlayCatalogController001 — implementation logic
views.introduction: Three helpers for reviewed catalogue selection and task-bound stage lifecycle. Cost/labels are fixtures; no learned routing, native paging, or execution authority.

views.heading: # ContextRetrieval001 — software context logic
views.introduction: Three read-only helpers of the existing context contract. Exact source-aware packets use a canonical-JSON byte budget. Native HSA/MSA, learned retrieval, tokenization and task mutation remain absent.

views.heading: # BoundedLearnerCoordinator001 logic
views.introduction: Fixed local workflow through proposal. Dataset/candidate/evaluation owners stay authoritative; partial or unsupported acceptance fails closed.

views.heading: # CandidateAcceptance001 — bounded integrated acceptance logic
views.introduction: A separate installed candidate-evidence adapter closes the local human-assisted learning/adoption/rollback loop. Roles remain attestations; no self-approval, native Runtime permit, generic neural-state migration or production authority.

views.heading: # PersistentState001 — reviewed scoped state logic
views.introduction: Three helper flows extend existing Generations/TaskRecord and read-only context. Local reviewer labels are attestations; data is not root instruction, permission, truth or learned temporal state.
